scope: Documentation and usability investigation; no C++ changes or rebuild; not a full acceptance gate

environment.home: Isolated temporary directory; no existing stored secrets
environment.proxy: Trailing slash removed only in probe subprocess environment; no global setting changes

artifacts.load_preparation: Copy each existing DuckOMO artifact to $PROBE/<version>/duckomo.duckdb_extension to preserve its canonical entrypoint name. Development-path binaries were older; they were not used for the final observations.
artifacts.reproduction: Run from $REPO; substitute $REPO and $PROBE in SQL. Create an isolated $PROBE/home. Artifacts are ignored local build outputs, not newly distributed binaries.
